luau: Luau allocates GC objects from per-size-class pages, so a fresh mlua Luau state reports about 436 KB from Lua::used_memory(), of which about 182 KB is resident before our call function, limits, and sandbox are added (separate diagnostic, 1,000 states).
boa: boa_gc collects with stop-the-world mark and sweep: the median batch hides the pauses, so toolCallWallMeanUs and toolCallCpuUs are about twice toolCallWallUs, and the slowest 1,000-call batch averaged 626 us per call (one pause of roughly 0.6 s).
steel: memorySessions stopped at the 3 GiB growth budget (252 live sessions); startRuns is the at-least-40 slow-engine count.
roto: The tool-call loop is compiled machine code making three direct native calls per iteration, so it measures Roto's FFI and native-call cost rather than an interpreter.
